name: Ban Lists
description: Every TCG Forbidden & Limited List (May 2002 - September 2026) for online lobbies, picked by era and year.
details: 82 TCG lists sourced from formatlibrary.com; card release dates from ygoprodeck.com. Each list only allows the cards released in the TCG by its date (a period format: Goat, Edison, HAT...). Hosting a match: Ban list > Choose a list... opens the picker page (pages\banlists.bob). Joiners with Yu-Gi-Oh-MP get the host's list from the lobby. The Yugi-Kaiba Format folder is the older single-player pd_limits mod for May 2002.
